description: Vet-designed dog gear brand founded by emergency veterinarian Dr Duncan Houston (BVSc, University of Sydney), operated by Australian Premium Animal Products Ltd, Hong Kong. Its range covers front-clip harnesses, leads and collars, waterproof collars, chew toys, snuffle/lick enrichment, memory-foam beds, a Smart ID Tag and a GPS tracker. Its Ambassador Programme is creator-first: creators on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube of any size, plus trainers, groomers, walkers, clubs and rescues.

evidence.summary: Official Ambassador Programme page: 10% commission on every sale through a personal code/link, tracked in a Social Snowball dashboard, a personal discount code for the audience, manual approval, and disclosure required on every post.

Explicit uncapped wording in two places on the official page: '10% commission — On every sale through your code or link, with no monthly cap' and the FAQ: '10% of every sale made through your personal code or link, with no monthly cap... paid out on the first business day of each month.'

The program actively recruits small/new creators: 'Creators with a dog — Instagram, TikTok or YouTube, any size'; FAQ: 'I have a small account. Is it worth applying? A small account whose followers actually own dogs and trust you is exactly who this is for. We approve on the dog, the content and the audience, not the follower count.' Applications are read by a person in a founder-led review.
Terms state woopf.com is operated by Australian Premium Animal Products Ltd, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, and publish 'Questions: hello@woopf.com' with the contact form at woopf.com/pages/contact.
Homepage: '100% veterinarian owned · Founded by Dr Duncan Houston, BVSc' and a 'SEEN ON SOCIAL • SHOP THE CLIP' section of real dogs in real homes filmed by owners and by Dr Duncan himself.

name: WOOPF

opportunity.title: WOOPF Ambassador Programme — 10% commission, no monthly cap

reasons.compensation: Published 10% on every sale with an explicit no-monthly-cap statement in both the body copy and the FAQ; payout monthly via Social Snowball.
reasons.contact_access: Published general email hello@woopf.com in the Terms plus a contact form and a public ambassador application page.
reasons.credibility: Vet-owned and founder-led, with full Terms/Privacy naming the legal operator and its Hong Kong address.
reasons.niche_fit: Pure pet gear — harnesses, toys, beds, ID/GPS — a direct fit for pet creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Live application via Social Snowball from the ambassador hub; any-size creators and non-social professionals are eligible.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The homepage is built around owner-filmed 'Shop the Clip' social video, and the ambassador programme requires creators to use the gear on their own dog and post with their code.

description: Family-owned human-grade pet food company based in Rye, New York, making 'home cooked style' whole-food, limited-ingredient, low-carb recipes for dogs and cats formulated with veterinarian Dr. Karen Becker, with every ingredient traceable and each batch lab-tested. Its affiliate program runs on ShareASale at a published 10% per sale.

evidence.summary: Lasso listing: 'Commission Rate: 10% Per Sale, Cookie Duration: 15 Days', program category Pet, with the join link going to ShareASale; the page FAQ repeats that the Raised Right Pets affiliate commission rate is 10% per sale.
The brand's own sign-up guide, hosted on raisedrightpets.com, directs applicants to ShareASale merchant ID 86163 to join the program, with commissions funded by Raised Right via ShareASale escrow.

Beacons Universe (updated Oct 18, 2026): posts from 16 creators all time, 55 mentions all time, 5 public posts mentioning Raised Right in the last 12 months, and no creator posted about it in the 30 days to November 20, 2026 — clear low-saturation evidence. Lists 1-50 employees, based in Rye, New York.
Official FAQ/footer publishes info@raisedrightpets.com and phone 1-844-777-3871, delivery to all 48 contiguous US states, and food gently cooked in a USDA-inspected human-grade facility.

name: Raised Right

opportunity.title: Raised Right Pets Affiliate Program — 10% per sale via ShareASale

reasons.compensation: Published 10% per sale on ShareASale with a 15-day cookie; no cap statement was found, so the cap is honestly unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Published info@raisedrightpets.com and phone on the official site and FAQ.
reasons.credibility: Family-owned, HQ and officers documented by PetfoodIndustry, USDA-inspected facility claim on the official FAQ.
reasons.niche_fit: Fresh, human-grade dog and cat food from a family-owned brand — squarely in the pets brief.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open ShareASale join flow documented in the brand's own sign-up guide.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Beacons shows real creator posts (Instagram reels/posts by named creators), but very sparse — which is the opportunity.

description: Singapore planted-aquarium brand (2Hr Aquarist Pte. Ltd.) founded by aquascaper Dennis Wong, selling APT fertilisers and planted-tank products built around its '2Hr Way' methodology. It runs an Ambassador Program plus a Super Affiliate Program open to non-ambassadors, with link-based tracking via BixGrow, and its online store serves the US, Canada, Europe, Australia and selected parts of Asia.

evidence.summary: Official Partner Us page — Super Affiliate Program: 'While Amazon and other platforms typically pay 3-4% commissions for similar products, we give a cool 15% to 20%.' The affiliate section adds that the program is open to interested folks beyond brand ambassadors, affiliates enjoy up to 20% commission and users get up to 12% discount; payouts monthly via PayPal with a $50 threshold.

Ambassador perks on the same page: a US$100–$250 gift card to start, a direct line to HQ and the horticulturist team, and priority access; the page notes most affiliates earn $20–$100+ per month. No creator-count source was fetched, so saturation is unknown, not low.

Privacy Policy publishes info@2hraquarist.com and the registered address: 2Hr Aquarist Pte. Ltd., 22 Sin Ming Lane, Midview City, #06-76, Singapore 573969; the Industry Partnership page confirms HQ in Singapore.

name: The 2Hr Aquarist

opportunity.title: The 2Hr Aquarist Super Affiliate Program — 15% to 20% commission

reasons.compensation: The highest published rate in this group: 15–20% (up to 20%) on the official page, monthly PayPal; no cap statement found, so the cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Published info@2hraquarist.com in the official Privacy Policy.
reasons.credibility: Registered Pte. Ltd. with a full Singapore address, and HQ, distributor and dealer programs documented on the official site.
reasons.niche_fit: Aquatics is an explicit pets sub-category, and the planted-tank niche is underserved next to dog and cat food.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The affiliate program is explicitly open beyond ambassadors, with a live dashboard link on the partner page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is built for hobbyist creators sharing build threads, videos and group posts, plus a formal Ambassador tier.

description: Smart home-safety brand founded in 2013 making smoke alarms, carbon monoxide and combination alarms, heat alarms, water-leak sensors and environmental sensors, including interconnected and Wi-Fi smart versions. Its official affiliate page targets website owners, bloggers and online marketers who share banners and text links on social media.

evidence.summary: Official affiliate page: 9%-16% commission (earn up to 16% per successful referral), 30-day cookie, monthly payouts and 'unlimited earning potential'. Its FAQ answers 'How much can you earn?' with: 'There is no earning limit. The more customers you refer, the more you earn!' — the explicit wording that qualifies the cap as uncapped. Paid by the 20th of each month, free to join.

Press release: founded in 2013, safeguarded more than 15 million households, range of smoke alarms, CO detectors and environmental sensors; media contact X-SENSE ELECTRONICS LLC, partners@x-sense.com, Delaware, website x-sense.com.
Release lists the company's official social profiles as facebook.com/xsense.global and instagram.com/xsense.global — the source for the socials recorded here.

name: X-Sense

opportunity.title: X-Sense Affiliate Program — 9%-16% commission, no earning limit

reasons.compensation: Published 9%-16% range with monthly payouts, and the FAQ explicitly says there is no earning limit / unlimited earning potential.
reasons.contact_access: Published partners@x-sense.com partnerships email plus a public affiliate page; no named affiliate manager.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2013 with 15M households claimed in a press release; the network name is not stated on the official page.
reasons.niche_fit: Smart home safety — connected alarms and sensors — is a strong home-tech fit.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Live official affiliate page with a Join Now / register route.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The affiliate page invites bloggers and marketers to share on social media, but no product-seeding UGC/review flow was found on a fetched page.

description: Vancouver, Canada-based natural home scenting and air-care brand, founded in 2014, offering diffusers and humidifiers that use essential oils, positioned in design-centric home goods. Its official 'Home Team' page invites content creators who share its passion for beautiful, natural air care to join as affiliates.

evidence.summary: Official Home Team affiliate page: commissions on every sale via a unique code/link, creators have earned over $200k in commissions, gifted full suite of products, first access and social spotlight; JOIN NOW links to Shopify Collabs. No percentage rate is published on the page.

Official contact page publishes partnerships@vitruvi.com for brand partnerships, press@vitruvi.com for press and hello@vitruvi.com for general inquiries, and directs content creators to apply to the affiliate program.

Beacons Universe: 102 creators have posted about Vitruvi all time, only 13 public posts in the last 12 months and only 1 sponsored post in that period — a small creator footprint supporting low saturation. Also lists Vitruvi as based in Vancouver, Canada, 1-50 employees, home fragrance/wellness.
CB Insights: Vitruvi offers natural home scenting and air care products, diffusers and humidifiers using essential oils; founded 2014, based in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Vitruvi

reasons.compensation: Commission on every sale is promised but no percentage is published on any fetched page, so the rate is null and compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: Dedicated published partnerships, press and general emails plus a direct creator application route — top band.
reasons.credibility: Established 2014 Vancouver brand with an official program page and third-party company profiles.
reasons.niche_fit: Core home fragrance and air-care brand, squarely in the home brief.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Live JOIN NOW / APPLY NOW route via Shopify Collabs on the official site.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official creator program with $200k+ commissions claimed, gifting and social spotlight; Beacons tracks 102 creators and one sponsored post in the last 12 months.

description: GL.iNet makes OpenWrt-based networking gear, best known for compact travel routers, plus home routers, IoT gateways and remote KVM devices with OpenVPN and WireGuard pre-installed. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Hong Kong (GL Technologies (Hong Kong) Limited), it runs an Awin affiliate program and a separate influencer program offering product samples and early access.

evidence.summary: Awin merchant profile for GL Technologies (Hong Kong) Limited: 'Welcome to The GL.iNet Affiliate Program! Here you can earn up to 10% commission on each affiliate sale by promoting the best-selling travel routers.' Join by registering on Awin; questions to marketing@gl-inet.com, published on the page.

Official Influencer Program page: seeks influencers in technology, cybersecurity, networking, travel, remote work, IoT, VPN and tech gadgets; benefits are product samples, early access to review new products and exclusive updates, with an application form on the page.

Official Black Friday Creator Rewards page: earn up to US$800 per creator ($100 per 20K qualifying views, $800 max at 160K+) for one video on YouTube, Instagram Reels or TikTok published Nov 1–Dec 1, 2026 (UTC+8); creators 18+ with no minimum follower count required.

name: GL.iNet

opportunity.title: GL.iNet Black Friday Creator Rewards — earn up to US$800 per creator for one video (Nov 1–Dec 1, 2026, UTC+8; no minimum follower count)

reasons.compensation: The Awin listing states up to 10% commission (exact tier not published); the separate creator campaign pays up to $800 per creator by views.
reasons.contact_access: Published marketing@gl-inet.com on the Awin program page, plus an influencer application form on the official site.
reasons.credibility: Commission and contact come from the program's Awin merchant profile; campaign terms are fully detailed on the brand's own page.
reasons.niche_fit: Travel routers and networking gadgets are core consumer tech for travel, remote-work and VPN creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: A dated, live opportunity: Black Friday Creator Rewards, Nov 1–Dec 1, 2026, explicitly with no minimum follower count.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A standing influencer program (samples, early review access) plus a paid, view-based creator rewards campaign on the official site.

description: Paperlike makes the paper-feel iPad screen protector using its Nanodots surface technology, for drawing and writing with Apple Pencil in apps such as Procreate, Goodnotes and Notability, plus related iPad accessories; it is designed in Germany and manufactured in Switzerland, with the company in Hamburg, founded in 2017. It runs both a creator community (free product, pool for future paid campaigns) and a separate affiliate program.

evidence.summary: Official affiliate/creator page: 'Apply to our affiliate program to earn 10% commission on every purchase made through your affiliate link'; the FAQ confirms 10% on every sale within 30 days. Creator community members receive a free Screen Protector and join the pool for future paid campaigns; the brand seeks creators with over 5K followers.
Live Sprout Social Creator Hub application page: 'Please complete our application if you are interested in being considered for potential collaborations and partnerships' (selection not guaranteed).
Official Paperlike blog states its handles — @paperlike on Instagram and Threads, @paperlikeofficial on TikTok — the source for the socials recorded here.
CB Insights: Paperlike founded in 2017, headquarters Hamburg, Germany; produces iPad accessories, particularly a screen protector giving a paper-like surface for Apple Pencil notetaking and drawing.

name: Paperlike

opportunity.title: Paperlike Creator Community — free Screen Protector, feature on brand socials, and pool for future paid campaigns (creators with over 5K followers)

reasons.compensation: Published 10% commission on every sale within 30 days; paid campaigns are separate and unpriced publicly.
reasons.contact_access: Two live public application routes (creator community and affiliate); no published partnerships email was found.
reasons.credibility: All terms taken from the brand's own affiliates/creators page and its live application portal.
reasons.niche_fit: Single-category iPad/desk accessory with a clear creator audience of digital artists and notetakers.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Creator community application is open now via Sprout Social, with a stated 5K+ follower threshold.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Dedicated creator community, creators featured on brand socials, and explicit paid collaborations (e.g. annual Back-to-School content) on the official page.

description: Hi-Fi audio platform founded in 2016 by the Crazy HiFi team, bringing Chinese HiFi makers to listeners worldwide and housing its own brands THIEAUDIO, Kiwi Ears, ZiiGaat and Tripowin, selling in-ear monitors, headphones and DAC/AMPs. Its Programs page lists Affiliate, Product Ambassador (receive upcoming products for review) and Loyal Community (test and review products) routes for creators.

evidence.summary: Official affiliate page: performance-based commissions of 5%-18% per referred sale, a custom unique link, 14-day cookies and UpPromote tracking; new affiliates earn 5%, payments are processed around the 10th of each month with a USD $10 minimum payout, free to join with no minimum sales quota. No cap or earning-limit statement appears on the page, so the cap is unknown.

UpPromote register page: commission type Percent Of Sale at 5%, with a tiered structure — Tier 1 $0-5,000 5%, Tier 2 $5,000-10,000 8%, Tier 3 $10,000-50,000 10%, Tier 4 $50,000-100,000 12%, Tier 5 $100,000-150,000 15%, Tier 6 $150,000+ 18% — evaluated quarterly.

Programs page: Affiliate Program under 'Create & review' (5%-18%, 14-day cookies), a Product Ambassador route (receive upcoming products for review and help manufacturers refine products) and a Loyal Community route (test and review products, sometimes before launch, with an original review and photos).

About page: Linsoul began with the Crazy HiFi team in 2016, built around audiophile communities, bringing Chinese HiFi makers closer to listeners worldwide; its own brands are THIEAUDIO, Kiwi Ears, ZiiGaat and Tripowin.

name: Linsoul

opportunity.title: Linsoul Affiliate Program (UpPromote) plus Product Ambassador / Loyal Community review programs

reasons.compensation: Fully published tiered 5%-18%, $10 minimum payout, monthly payment; no cap statement found, so the cap remains unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A live UpPromote application and a published PR email (joyce@linsoul.com); no direct affiliate email published on fetched pages.
reasons.credibility: Detailed official about, affiliate terms and parent-company pages; 2016 founding corroborated across official and press-release sources.
reasons.niche_fit: Niche audiophile audio accessories (IEMs, headphones, DAC/AMPs) at the smaller creator-friendly end, not a mass headphone giant.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Live register page plus multiple creator programs listed on the official Programs page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Separate Product Ambassador and Loyal Community test-and-review programs alongside the affiliate program, with authentic-content guidance on the affiliate page.

description: JOURNEY is a consumer electronics and lifestyle accessories brand, described on its official site as an ALOGIC brand creating innovative consumer electronics, with products designed in Australia. Its range includes wireless charging desk mats and charging stations, plus LOC8 trackable wallets and tracker accessories that work with Apple Find My and Google Find Hub, sold through regional stores for the US, UK, Australia and worldwide.

evidence.summary: Official 'Journey Official Global Affiliate Program' page: publishers earn 15% commission on each sale, average order value $100, 30-day cookie, monthly paychecks; sign-up routes to ShareASale. The page also states the products are designed in Australia.

Official press release (Melbourne, Australia dateline) describes JOURNEY as 'an ALOGIC brand' in innovative consumer electronics, launches the LOC8 VERSA Slim trackable wallet, publishes pr@journeyofficial.com for media enquiries, and repeats: 'Publishers earn 15% on each sale, and our program is free to join.'

name: JOURNEY

reasons.compensation: The highest verified tech rate in this group: 15% per sale on a stated $100 average order value, 30-day cookie, monthly pay.
reasons.contact_access: Published PR email pr@journeyofficial.com plus a public affiliate sign-up page.
reasons.credibility: Detailed terms (rate, AOV, cookie, payout cadence) published on the brand's own affiliate page.
reasons.niche_fit: Core consumer tech: wireless charging desk accessories and trackable phone wallets/trackers.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The affiliate program is public and free to join, but no named, dated creator opportunity was found.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is framed for publishers/affiliates; no explicit creator/UGC campaign was found on fetched pages.

description: Camp Snap makes reusable, screen-free digital cameras designed to help people stay present — no playback screen, point-and-shoot operation — originally created for children at summer camp and now also sold to adult nostalgia and travel audiences. Its official About page says it was founded by Brian and Melanie, former summer campers from Toronto now living in Hermosa Beach, California; Beacons lists it as an electronics brand based in Redondo Beach, US, with 1–50 employees.

evidence.summary: Official ambassador page: apply via Superfiliate for a personal link and commission on every sale, early access and campaign features; or via ShopMy — 'Add Camp Snap to your Shop and earn 10% commission on every sale' — plus creator challenges and bonuses.
Live Superfiliate ambassador sign-up portal: asks for Instagram (required) and optionally TikTok/YouTube/Substack/Pinterest/X, and states PayPal is how commissions are paid out.

Beacons Universe (updated Nov 19, 2026): 461 creators have posted about Camp Snap all time (102 in the 30 days to Nov 20, 2026); brand listed under Electronics, based in Redondo Beach, United States, 1–50 employees — a small all-time creator footprint for the brand's scale, supporting a 'low' saturation call.

Official About page: founded by Brian and Melanie after finding no screen-free digital cameras for kids; the cameras are designed to help children stay present and capture camp memories without screen time. The brand's official contest page identifies @campsnapcamera as its official Instagram account.

name: Camp Snap

opportunity.title: Camp Snap Ambassador Program (Superfiliate) — personal link, commission on every sale, early access to drops, campaign/community features

reasons.compensation: Published 10% commission on all sales via ShopMy; the Superfiliate ambassador rate is not published on the fetched pages.
reasons.contact_access: Public Superfiliate application portal only; no published partnerships/PR email was found.
reasons.credibility: Program and 10% rate are on the brand's own ambassador page and live portal; creator counts come from Beacons, a third-party listing.
reasons.niche_fit: A distinctive gadget — screen-free digital cameras and Super 8-style camcorders — squarely consumer tech, with lifestyle/family creator overlap.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Both the ambassador (Superfiliate) and ShopMy creator routes are open for application now.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Ambassador program built around creator content, campaign features and community challenges; Beacons tracks 461 creators posting about the brand all time.
